resources.string: Choose a password of 12–256 characters and keep it safe. This file cannot be recovered if you forget it.
Enter the password used when exporting this file.
Plain JSON can be read directly and includes your usage records and settings. Store it only in a trusted location.
Wrong password or damaged encrypted file. Check and try again.
Export was interrupted. Start the export again.
New folder copies will be plain JSON. Existing encrypted files still require their original password; existing plain files are not converted.
Encryption covers exported files and optional folder copies. Local history and recovery snapshots stay in private app storage without password encryption. Existing copies are not converted.

Choose 12–256 characters. The copy password is encrypted with Android Keystore and kept on this device for future automatic copies. Old files keep their original password. Forgotten passwords cannot be recovered.
